findings.rationale: Valid: C6 now also unsets GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS, GIT_CONFIG_COUNT and every GIT_CONFIG_KEY_n/VALUE_n, and the pre-flight asserts core.hooksPath is empty or inside the temp tree, red-checked under git -c core.hooksPath=<outside>.

Valid: the wrapper ran a full hippo check per commit. A3.4 step 9 now execs hippo hook <name>, which refuses only problems the commit introduces (hippo spec 11.5 New = P(staged) minus P(HEAD)); a store in hippo-problems keeps accepting clean commits; full check exit 3 is reported by session-start. Consistent with KR-A3.3 and the 3.3 state table.

Valid: A3.1 decision new gains --ledger-row <id> (key sha256(row id)[0:16], idempotent); step 6 uses it; W20 names decision new --ledger-row; a hippo-mode decision new without --ledger-row whose title matches a ledger-filed decision in the last 24 h exits 2 (zero-choice, loud).

Valid: pre-push now also diffs frozen paths over the whole range (tip tree vs remote sha or merge-base with origin/develop) when the tip has repo.toml; red-check: pre-cutover lane edit carried in by merge is blocked.
Folded: the repo.toml test reads the staged index for pre-commit/pre-merge-commit, so a rollback revert deleting it is not checked.

Folded: Windows paragraph no longer expects a spool host to commit; per-host evidence is the P1.5 transcript (version, sha256, hippo check, hook-refusal run); section 4 graph lists P1.5 as an A3.7 input.
Folded: C8 mechanism commit carries the inventory rows and counts its own gates check.
